headlines.description: Deshaun Watson matched his career high with five touchdown passes to lead the Houston Texans to their fifth straight victory, 42-23 over the Miami Dolphins on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Watson throws 5 TDs as Texans beat Dolphins 42-23

headlines.description: Carson Wentz threw three touchdown passes to different players as the Philadelphia Eagles defeated the Jacksonville Jaguars 24-18 at Wembley Stadium on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wentz's 3 TD passes give Eagles win vs. Jags in London

events.name: New York Jets at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: Mitchell Trubisky threw for two touchdowns, and the short-handed Chicago Bears beat the New York Jets 24-10 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Trubisky throws 2 TDs as Bears beat Jets 24-10

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Cincinnati Bengals

headlines.description: Jessie Bates returned Jameis Winston's fourth interception for a touchdown Sunday, and Randy Bullock kicked a 44-yard field goal on the final play that sent the Cincinnati Bengals to a 37-34 victory over the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, who now have a...
headlines.shortLinkText: Bengals pick off Winston 4 times for 37-34 win over Bucs

headlines.description: Russell Wilson threw three touchdown passes in the second quarter to put the Seattle Seahawks ahead and they went on to beat the Detroit Lions 28-14 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wilson throws 3 TDs in 2nd quarter, Seahawks top Lions 28-14

events.name: Denver Broncos at Kansas City Chiefs

headlines.description: Patrick Mahomes threw for 303 yards and four touchdowns, Sammy Watkins had 107 yards receiving and two of the scores, and the Chiefs beat Denver 30-23 on Sunday to wrap up a sweep of the Broncos and keep their stranglehold on the AFC West as their...
headlines.shortLinkText: Chiefs complete season sweep of Broncos with 30-23 victory

events.name: Washington Redskins at New York Giants

headlines.description: Safety D.J. Swearinger intercepted two passes, Matt Ioannidis had 2 1/2 sacks, and the NFC East-leading Washington Redskins rode their defense to a third straight win, a 20-13 decision over the offensively inept New York Giants on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Redskins win third straight, behind defense and Peterson

headlines.description: Ben Roethlisberger threw two touchdown passes to Antonio Brown, James Conner scored twice, and the Pittsburgh Steelers beat the Cleveland Browns 33-18 on Sunday to bring some solace to a city grieving from tragedy.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers down Browns 33-18 a day after synagogue shooting

headlines.description: Cam Newton torched the league's No. 1-ranked defense, completing 21 of 29 passes for 219 yards and two touchdowns and running for 52 yards and another score as the Carolina Panthers defeated the Baltimore Ravens 36-21 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Newton scores 3 TDs, Panthers defeat Ravens 36-21

headlines.description: Andrew Luck threw his third touchdown pass of the game to break a tie with 5:28 to go and the Indianapolis Colts won in consecutive weeks for the first time in three years, beating the Oakland Raiders 42-28 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Luck's 3 TD passes lead Colts past Raiders 42-28

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: Greg Zuerlein hit a 34-yard field goal with 2:05 left and Ramik Wilson forced and recovered Ty Montgomery's fumble on the ensuing kickoff return, allowing the Los Angeles Rams to remain unbeaten without a late defensive stand in a 29-27 victory over...
headlines.shortLinkText: Late fumble keeps Rams unbeaten with 29-27 win over Packers

headlines.description: Josh Rosen threw a 9-yard touchdown pass to fellow rookie Christian Kirk with 34 seconds to play to rally the Arizona Cardinals to an 18-15 victory over the San Francisco 49ers on Sunday in a matchup of teams with two of the worst records in the NFL.

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Minnesota Vikings

headlines.description: Drew Brees and the New Orleans Saints paid Minnesota back for their last-second loss in the playoffs last season, using two key turnovers, including a 45-yard interception return by P.J. Williams, to fuel a 30-20 victory over the Vikings on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Saints get revenge for 'miracle' in 30-20 win over Vikings

events.name: New England Patriots at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: Devin McCourty returned an interception 84 yards for a touchdown, and the New England Patriots' defense smothered the Buffalo Bills' anemic offense in a 25-6 win on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: McCourty's pick-6 seals Patriots' 25-6 win over Bills
